case.title: Hours cut, declines member support
case.script: Verified. Says his employer cut his hours in half last month and he cannot pay anything now. Asks if the interest can be frozen. Does not want to be transferred.
checks: cut working hours counts as hardship
one sentence of sympathy, no persuasion attempt although the band is serious
no interest freeze, discount or plan offered
add_note p1 'hardship' before close_call (single product still gets a note)
